subject: Launch playlist & cutover windows — Halcyon Retail
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Craig Turner <craig@halcyonretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Launch playlist & cutover windows — Halcyon Retail

Hi Craig —

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Attached is a first-pass launch playlist (halcyon_map_v1.xlsx) and a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that breaks our go-live into three milestones with proposed owners, dates, and acceptance criteria. High-level summary: 

- Milestone A — Integration & Data Prep (owner: Halcyon IT, Redwood support) — target: 2026-11-01
- Milestone B — UAT & Performance Validation (owner: Halcyon Product, Redwood CS) — target: 2026-11-15
- Milestone C — Cutover & Go-Live (owner: Halcyon Ops, Redwood Implementation) — target: 2026-11-22

Key asks for this week: 
1) Confirm owners above or propose alternates by EOD Friday (10/09).
2) Confirm the UAT window — we currently have 11/08–11/12 as the preferred slot; if that conflicts please propose two alternative weeks.
3) Share any procurement/contract contacts so we can surface the SOW for signature. I’ve attached the SOW draft (SOW_draft_v0.3.docx) for procurement review.

Risks I flagged in the doc: data schema discrepancies on product feed, and potential quota limits on peak inference traffic. We’ll propose mitigation steps once owners are confirmed.

I’ll schedule a 30-minute owner alignment call for next Wednesday (10/07) and will update if we need to shift.

Thanks,
Jordan
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: halcyon_map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_draft_v0.3.docx (doc)

From: Craig Turner <craig@halcyonretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch playlist & cutover windows — Halcyon Retail

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear draft. Quick notes from our side: 
- We can own Milestone A and C as suggested. For Milestone B (UAT) I need to move the window one week later because of a retail blackout week — can we shift UAT to 11/15–11/19 and push cutover to 11/29?
- Procurement: looping in our procurement partner (procurement@procureone.com) — they’ll handle SOW/PO.
- On the product feed: our data team needs a short sample mapping to validate fields; can Ben share the expected schema and a quick validation script?

If the new UAT/cutover dates cause any internal conflicts, tell me and we’ll find an alternate. Happy to review the SOW next week.

— Craig
Director, Product Operations
Halcyon Retail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch playlist & cutover windows — Halcyon Retail

Craig / Jordan —

Thanks, Craig — shifting UAT to 11/15–11/19 and cutover to 11/29 is workable from a CS readiness perspective. I updated the owner column in the MAP (see attached halcyon_map_v1.xlsx, sheet "Owners_v2"). Quick operational notes and proposed owners: 

- Integration & Data Prep (10/11–10/31) 
  - Halcyon: Data Engineering (Craig) — deliver sample mapping by 10/12
  - Redwood: Integration SME (Ben) — provide schema + validation script by 10/09

- UAT & Performance Validation (11/15–11/19) 
  - Halcyon: Product & QA — provide acceptance test cases by 11/05
  - Redwood: CS (Marissa) & SRE (Ben) — run two controlled performance runs during UAT; success = < 200ms p50 and no critical errors in 5 consecutive runs

- Cutover & Go-Live (11/29) 
  - Halcyon: Ops — run pre-cutover checklist and approve go/no-go by 11/28 18:00 local
  - Redwood: Implementation — monitoring bridge active for first 72 hours post-cutover

Action items for this thread: 
1) Ben — please attach schema and a short validation script to this thread by 10/09.
2) Craig — confirm the Halcyon Data lead name for the MAP owner cell (we need a person).
3) Procurement — if you can share any SOW redline requests, Jordan can coordinate SOW updates.

I’ll prepare a readiness checklist and an escalation path (owner + 24h contact) to include in the MAP.

Regards,
Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Craig Turner <craig@halcyonretail.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch playlist & cutover windows — Halcyon Retail

Folks —

Schema & validation script attached (implementation_lane_chart.pdf includes a one-page schematic and a link to the validation script repo). Summary of tech milestones (more granular):

1) Feed onboarding (10/11–10/20) — deliverable: sample feed + schema v1; owner: Halcyon DE / Ben provides sample loader and automated checks by 10/14.
2) API auth and routing tests (10/21–10/28) — deliverable: signed test token & routing policy; owner: Redwood infra (Ben).
3) Staging performance runs (11/01–11/05) — deliverable: perf report & tuning knobs; owner: Redwood SRE (Ben) + Halcyon QA.
4) UAT (11/15–11/19) — acceptance criteria reiterated below.

Known constraints: halcyon has a consumer peak window 11/22–11/25 (blackout for major promo). We must avoid scheduling cutover during that period. The revised plan respects that.

Risks & mitigations: 
- If we see schema mismatches, first mitigation is field-mapping script; if that fails within 48 hours, escalate to Jordan for resource allocation.
- If perf is marginal, we’ll enable temporary caching + restrict concurrency for the first 24h of go-live.

Attachments: implementation_lane_chart.pdf (diagram + repo link).

Ben
Implementation Lead
Redwood Inference

Subject: Halcyon / Redwood SOW & billing questions

Jordan / Craig —

Procurement here. We reviewed SOW_draft_v0.3.docx and have a couple of items before we can issue a PO: 
- Please confirm Redwood's preferred billing cadence (monthly vs net-30 invoice).
- We request a liability cap paragraph be added (we’ll propose wording next business day).
- Please provide the final SOW with a signature-ready DocuSign link.

We added Priyom (Redwood legal/sales ops) to the thread for redlines. Once the SOW is updated we’ll return a PO within standard timelines.

Link to signature packet (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/halcyon/sow/abc123

Regards,
Procurement Team
ProcureOne (vendor for Halcyon Retail)

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Confirm Redwood prefers monthly invoicing but we can accept net-30 on enterprise customers; Jordan notes: we’ll accept Halcyon’s PO with standard net-30 if preferred. Priyom — can you review the liability cap language and return a redline by 10/12?

Next steps (summary):
- Priyom: legal redlines on SOW by 10/12 (to procurement@procureone.com).
- Ben: validation script + repo link posted to MAP thread by 10/09 (ACTION: Ben).
- Craig: confirm named Data Engineering owner by 10/09.
- Marissa: readiness checklist & escalation path by 10/12.
- Procurement/Craig: sign SOW via DocuSign link once redlines are resolved.

I’ll lock a 30-minute owner alignment call for 10/12 10:00–10:30 PT and send the invite; please accept or propose an alternate. If that time works we’ll use it to confirm owners, acceptance test cases, and the SOW signing timeline.

Jordan
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
